name: 陳生明
objective:
介紹單位換算與有效數位，元素的原子結構、化學方程式平衡與計算，反應熱，氣體與氣體定律，大氣層與環境污染，週期表，化學鍵，化合物的分子結構，熱力學，動力學，反應機構，平衡常數，氧化與還原，酸鹼反應，電化學，混合物的分離及現代科技材料，奠定良好化學基礎。

  The course is designed for chemical engineering major. The topics explore chemistry at a greater depth and with more emphasis on concepts, problems, and calculations. Topics include significant figures, thermochemistry, gases, quantum theory and the electronic structure of atoms, periodic relationships, chemical bonding, chemical reaction, oxidation-reduction reaction, chemical kinetics, chemical equilibrium, acids and bases, changes of states, synthetic polymer materials, electrochemistry.
課程進度(1-16週):
First week: Chemical Foundations & Periodic Table
Second week: Chemical foundations & Periodic Table
Third week: Atoms, Molecules, and Ions
Fourth week: Atoms, Molecules, and Ions & Stoichiometry
Fifth week: Stoichiometry
Sixth week: Types of Chemical Reaction and Solution Stoichiometry
Seventh week: Types of Chemical Reaction and Solution Stoichiometry & Gas
Eighth week: Gas
Ninth week: Midterm exam
Tenth week  Thermochemistry
Eleventh week: Thermochemistry & Atomic Structure and Periodicty
Twelfth week: Atomic Structure and Periodicity
Thirteenth week: Bonding: General Concepts
Fourteenth week: Bonding: General Concepts & Covalent Bonding: Orbitals
Fifteenth week: Covalent Bonding: Orbitals
Sixteenth week: Final exam
Seventeenth week: Flexible Learning
Eighteenth week: Flexible Learning
彈性學習(17-18週):
類別
		  
		    ● 學生分組實作及討論 (Student group practice and discussion)
● 遠距教學 (Distance learning)
		  
      

      
        內容
        
          第 17 週 & 第 18 週於原課表時段採取同步遠距教學，將進行期末專題分組口頭報告與即時答詢，包含教師線上講授與即時 QA 問答，課程將全程錄影，並且繳交專題報告檔案以進行評分。

  During Weeks 17 and 18, synchronous online classes will be conducted. The sessions will include group oral presentations of the final projects and real-time Q & A, along with online instruction and interactive question-and-answer sessions led by the instructor. The entire course will be recorded, and students are required to submit their project report files for evaluation.
        
      

      
        時數 (小時)
        
          6
        
      

      
        學習成果
        
          學生需於在口頭報告之前繳交期末報告檔案 (PPT/PDF) 到指定繳交區，並於口頭報告當天進行分組報告，教師會進行評量與問答。

  Students are required to submit their final project report files (PPT/PDF) to the designated submission area before the oral presentation. On the day of the oral presentation, each group will give its presentation, followed by evaluation and Q & A conducted by the instructor.
        
      

      
        評量比例
        
          彈性學習 (17-18 週) / Flexible Learning (Week 17-18)

● 期末分組口頭報告與期末報告檔案佔總成績 10%
  (The final group oral presentation and final project report file account             
   for 10% of the total grade.)
